name: Sean P. Murray
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Chicago, Illinois
side_practice_areas: Personal Injury, Medical Malpractice, Products Liability
education: Loyola University Chicago School of Law
about: Managing partner at Murray Legal Group in Chicago, Illinois, Sean P. Murray is a dedicated attorney providing reliable representation in personal injury law. Throughout his career, he has counseled clients in cases including construction injuries, automobile accidents, medical malpractice, product liability, sexual assaults, premises liability and workplace injuries, including the representation of union workers. Extending his services to people across Chicago, he stays committed to fighting for his clients’ rights and obtaining the full compensation they deserve.

An alumnus of Western Illinois University, Mr. Murray pursued his legal education at Loyola University Chicago School of Law. Upon receiving his Juris Doctor, he was admitted to practice law in Illinois in 2001. He is also licensed to practice before the U.S. District Courts for the Northern and Southern Districts of Illinois.

Over the course of his 25-year career, Mr. Murray has obtained multiple jury verdicts and settlements for his clients. He holds numerous record-setting outcomes, including the top E2 nightclub tragedy settlement and state-leading results for ankle, elderly wrongful death and minor finger injury claims. Notably, he received a $67.2 million federal jury verdict, including punitive damages, for a client who was injured in an explosion at a ConAgra grain bin. Rejecting the pretrial offer of just $4.1 million, he fought tirelessly to deliver the full accountability and justice his client deserved.

For the above verdict, Mr. Murray was awarded the Chicago Daily Law Bulletin Trial Lawyer Excellence Award. He was also selected by fellow attorneys to Illinois Leading Lawyers for his continuous efforts to protect his clients’ rights and ensure they are rightfully compensated for the injury and psychological distress. He is an active member of the Illinois Trial Lawyers Association, presently serving on its board of managers.
